name: OpenCode
notes: OpenCode recognises only name, description, license, compatibility and metadata in the frontmatter; other fields are ignored.
prerequisites: OpenCode with a configured model provider
Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine

docs.title: Agent Skills (OpenCode)
docs.facts: Project .opencode/skills, .claude/skills and .agents/skills (walking up to the git worktree); global ~/.config/opencode/skills, ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills. Name rules match the Agent Skills spec; loaded through the native skill tool; permissions in opencode.json.

install.evidence: install.py put the skill in ~/.config/opencode/skills (OpenCode 1.18.35); docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#opencode

discovery.evidence: opencode debug skill lists reverse-design at that location; docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#opencode
